free_tier.stated: Peer-to-peer compute priced by each provider per CPU-hour; mainnet requestors pay in GLM plus gas. The only free lane is the testnet: tGLM is 'test currency that you can obtain for free to test your requestor node. These tokens have no real value.' GLM was USD 0.110439 on 2026-10-22.

interface_detail: inferred from the tooling the provider documents; not probed
chaining: At GLM USD 0.1104, a provider asking 0.1 GLM per CPU-hour costs about USD 0.011 per CPU-hour, below most list prices; the chain breaks on gas per agreement and on the thin provider market.

limits.value: Real capacity requires GLM on mainnet plus gas, which requires a purchase; the free testnet token carries no capacity guarantee.
